setup.effects: Build, migrate, prepare private settings and the native first owner; stop the temporary app.

dev.effects: Foreground app with assets/HMR, health-gated readiness and development outbox sign-in.

verify.effects: Run the complete nonrecursive verification target.

reset.effects: Explicitly confirmed deletion of the contained local inventory; no remote effect.

deploy.effects: Owner-account provision, migration, publication and health; dry-run builds/validates locally with no provider request.

export.effects: New private archive of supported local D1/FILES data with integrity and explicit exclusions.

import.effects: Confirmed validated atomic restore into an empty local destination; native identities retained.

install.effects: Frozen pinned dependency installation; no setup, global changes or deployment.

preview.effects: Serve fixed production output, preserve local owner and durable state, stop after idle timeout or explicit stop.

authentication: Owner-account deployment requires private CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN plus the secret environment inputs declared in deploy.json. Local native password/outbox sign-in requires no external provider credential. See OPERATIONS.md.

health.meaning: Native Worker with reachable D1 and R2; does not prove queues, sockets, providers or product acceptance.

acceptance.meaning: Product requirements and the evidence each requires; a passing result belongs to a named source revision.

configuration.description: Base deploy-kit owner-account resources and private secret inputs.
Native DB/FILES/JOBS/CONVERSATIONS bindings and scheduled recovery; generated migrations are collected before setup.
Selected optional runtime variable and private-secret allowlists; values never appear in describe/plan.
Local installation, remote prerequisites and publication, optional provider configuration and resumable local legacy import.

Optional RATE_LIMITS and AI_DAILY_CEILINGS JSON variables: public request limits (HTTP 429 with Retry-After) and per-UTC-day automatic AI ceilings per project and installation; GET /api/dashboard/projects/:projectId/ai-usage reports the day's usage.
Personal data stored and sent to configured providers, retention, and owner/admin contact erasure (POST /api/management/projects/:projectId/contacts/:contactId/erase or the dashboard contact page).

notes: Native HappyToHelp owner/password and magic-link auth is retained. Local sign-in uses the development outbox.
No CLI operation implies hosted or provider acceptance.
